title: dbt Model Timing Regression
dataSources: dbt Cloud Admin API runs (`dbtcloud:run`), Discovery API, and dbt artifacts (`dbt:run_results`, `dbt:manifest`).
app: dbt Cloud Admin API (`/api/v2/accounts/{id}/runs`) and Metadata (Discovery) API via HEC scripted inputs; dbt run artifacts (`run_results.json`, `manifest.json`) forwarded as `dbt:run_results`.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=dbt:run_results
| spath path=results{} output=results
| mvexpand results
| eval node=spath(results,"unique_id"), exec=spath(results,"execution_time")
| stats avg(exec) as avg_s, p95(exec) as p95_s by node
| where p95_s>60
| sort - p95_s
description: Parses per-model execution_time from dbt run_results artifacts and flags models whose 95th-percentile build time is slow, pointing at queries needing optimisation or incremental strategies.
value: A few slow models dominate transformation windows; model-level timing tells engineers exactly where to add incremental logic or better SQL.
implementation: Forward run_results.json after each run; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest models.
visualization: Table of model by p95 execution time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how long each dbt table takes to build so the slowest ones can be sped up before they hold up the batch.
